name: Elevator or Stairs?
justification: Wordy setup for a two-formula comparison; the only trap is the 3x door time and the tie going to the elevator.
solution_sketch: Stairs cost |x-y|*t1. Elevator must travel |z-x|+|x-y| floors at t2 plus 3 door operations (close, open, open). Print YES iff elevator <= stairs.
